name: Ocran
overview: The Scripture identifies Ocran as the father of Pagiel, a leader from the tribe of Asher who played a significant role in numbering the Israelites during the census. Pagiel, son of Ocran, is repeatedly mentioned as the captain or leader of the Asherites, emphasizing his responsibility in organizing and representing his tribe within the larger assembly of Israel. These references highlight Ocran's place in the genealogical and leadership structure of Israel during the wilderness period.
